keyEvents.text: Goal! Puebla 0, Pumas UNAM 1. Juninho (Pumas UNAM) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rodrigo López with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury José Pachuca (Puebla).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Puebla 1, Pumas UNAM 1. Omar Moreno (Puebla) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luifer Hernández.
Delay in match (Puebla).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Puebla 1, Pumas UNAM 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Robert Morales (Pumas UNAM).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Puebla. Kevin Velasco replaces Brayan Garnica.
Substitution, Puebla. Ignacio Maestro Puch replaces Luifer Hernández.
Adalberto Carrasquilla (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Rubén Duarte (Pumas UNAM).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Víctor Arteaga replaces César Huerta.
Pedro Vite (Pumas UNAM) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Puebla. Carlos Baltazar replaces Omar Moreno.
Substitution, Puebla. Ángel Leyva replaces José Pachuca.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Alan Medina replaces Uriel Antuna.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Álvaro Angulo replaces Rubén Duarte.
Substitution, Pumas UNAM. Luciano Herrera replaces Pedro Vite.
Goal! Puebla 1, Pumas UNAM 2. Álvaro Angulo (Pumas UNAM) header from very close range to the top left corner following a corner.
Second Half ends, Puebla 1, Pumas UNAM 2.
